summary.zh: 东亚赏樱的主角。绝大多数树是同一个克隆，因此全城同时开花。
summary.en: The star of East Asian cherry viewing. Most trees are a single clone, which is why a whole city blooms at once.

field_marks.zh: 先花后叶，花近白色略带粉，5 瓣；萼筒与花梗有毛；树形舒展。
field_marks.en: Blooms before leaves; near-white, faintly pink, five petals; hairy calyx tube and flower stalks; spreading crown.

similar.zh: 与山樱的区别：山樱花叶同放，且各株花期不一。
similar.en: Wild mountain cherries bloom with leaves emerging and vary in timing between trees.

story.zh: 染井吉野樱是杂交起源的栽培品种，分子指纹研究支持其亲本为江户彼岸樱与大岛樱，并以嫁接繁殖，所以遗传上几乎同一。同一基因型对气温响应一致，开花齐整。
story.en: A hybrid-origin cultivar; molecular fingerprinting supports Edo-higan and Oshima cherry as parents. It is propagated by grafting, so trees are essentially genetically identical and respond to temperature in unison.

note.zh: DNA 指纹研究杂交起源。

notes.zh: 花期随纬度由南向北推进：日本南部 3 月下旬，东京约 3 月底至 4 月初。花期短，满开约一周。
notes.en: The bloom front moves north: late March in southern Japan, around late March–early April in Tokyo. Full bloom lasts about a week.
